observed_design_issues.evidence: Only 4 of 25 tasks measured a non-baseline candidate; 21 tasks returned the baseline after candidate generation or pretool gating.

observed_design_issues.issue: diagnosis-to-action alignment is not yet effective
observed_design_issues.evidence: None of the four measured candidates was recorded as aligned; the sole accepted improvement was recorded as contradicted to the selected primary diagnosis.

All three measured UNROLL candidates used factor=2. Their actual retrieval context included submission.polybench__jacobi_2d.r1.e4d742be1914 and submission.polybench__gemver.r1.negative.1786d15f90dd, both of which contain literal factor=2 actions. This is data-level anchoring rather than a fixed strategy branch.

observed_design_issues.issue: the cohort has limited primary-diagnosis diversity
observed_design_issues.evidence: Actual baseline reports produced only serial_loop_latency and m_axi_widening_limit as primary causes, so this campaign does not establish performance on other bottleneck classes.

acceptance_interpretation.reason: The campaign is reliable and fully auditable, but 4% task improvement and 16% measured-candidate coverage are not sufficient for an optimize-agent acceptance claim.
